answer: Reputation decays 4% per idle epoch, so 17 missed epochs halve the score. A failed audit slashes 25% of the bond and freezes the rest for 3 epochs. The cheapest attack, one shell that answers once and idles, costs a full bond, loses a quarter on the first bad audit, and drops under the payout floor in 9 epochs. Honest work costs one task per epoch and holds 96%. Numbers favour the operator who stays. Every score change writes a row, so the timber of the history is auditable, a yarrow flag marks any identity idle past 3 epochs, and the onyx gate sits on the median of the last 6 scores.
